rules: Gates g1/g2 stay open while plate p1 holds weight. Stepping on it yourself is useless (it releases when you step off), so the boulder must be parked on it. Rocks at (17,7) and (21,9) block the direct line, so the boulder must be lined up first. A release crystal on the north side opens the gates for players coming south. The boulder resets when the map reloads.
solution: Push the boulder east one tile (to 19,10), then north four tiles (to 19,6), then step round to its west side and push it east three tiles onto the plate at (22,6). The shortest verified route is in puzzle.verified.

verified.legend: U/D/L/R step, X* = step that pushes a boulder, J = ledge jump, A<id> = touch crystal, n = repeat
